points: Junior share of technical hires fell from 27% to 9%; technical staff share of headcount from 61% to 56%
Agent work hours passed human hours in March 2026; about 80% of interactive session time is spent waiting for humans
Commits per engineer about 5x in six months, with no rise in reverted code (company's own data, unreviewed)
take: A rare inside view of a heavy agent user: fewer junior engineers, more time managing agents and meetings. A signal for workforce and graduate-hiring plans.
title: Anthropic: junior technical hiring falls from 27% to 9%
